title: It Is Important That: What Should Be Done With Resources

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *es importante que*, *es necesario que* and *es mejor que* from A2 Unit 27: after a value judgment about what others should do, the verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive. Debates about lithium and copper use them constantly: who should take part in decisions, who should benefit, what should be protected.

items.spanish: Es importante que los países usen el agua con cuidado cuando extraen litio.
items.english: It is important that countries use water carefully when they extract lithium.

items.spanish: Es necesario que las comunidades participen en las decisiones sobre los salares.
items.english: It is necessary that communities take part in decisions about the salt flats.

items.spanish: Es mejor que una parte del valor se quede en la región.
items.english: It is better that part of the value stays in the region.

items.spanish: Es una lástima que se exporte casi todo sin transformar.
items.english: It is a pity that almost everything is exported without being processed.

sections.content: With a new subject, use *que* and the present subjunctive (*usen*, *participen*, *se quede*). With no new subject, the infinitive is enough: *Es importante usar el agua con cuidado*.
